content: Completionists beware: Grand Theft Auto 6 is going to take you a very, very long time to complete. Rockstar Game’s open-world game is filled to the brim with things to do, see, and collect. You can go golfing, collect undersea treasures, find collectible trading cards, rack up medals at shooting ranges, scan landmarks, and so much more. Rockstar knows that it could get overwhelming fast, so GTA 6 was designed to combat that in one key way.
